assumptions.title: Human response window
assumptions.clarifying_question: Can a human respond before an effect becomes irreversible?
assumptions.failure_path: If external effects commit before the human intervention window, nominal review may not prevent them.

candidate_invariants.condition: When prior human approval is required, consequential effects wait for valid approval.

assumptions.title: Technical versus business idempotence
assumptions.clarifying_question: Does retry handling cover the entire business effect and its identity?
assumptions.failure_path: A lost acknowledgement can lead to a duplicate effect if deduplication does not cover providers and concurrent retry paths.

candidate_invariants.condition: One business intent cannot produce two distinct external effects within the declared boundary.

assumptions.title: Approval bound to actual payload
assumptions.clarifying_question: Is the human approving the effect-bearing payload or merely a generated summary?
assumptions.failure_path: Approval of a summary can differ from the downstream payload that actually executes.

candidate_invariants.condition: Approval binds the exact operation identity and effective payload.

assumptions.title: Delegation authority boundary
assumptions.clarifying_question: Can composed tool calls exceed the original authority?
assumptions.failure_path: Individually allowed tool calls may compose into an effect outside the original principal's scope.

candidate_invariants.condition: Delegated actions remain within original authority and scope.

assumptions.title: Atomicity at the effect boundary
assumptions.clarifying_question: Do reservations and external commits share the required concurrency guarantees?
assumptions.failure_path: A local budget check and external effect are not normally an atomic transaction; concurrency can violate a global ceiling.

candidate_invariants.condition: Aggregate committed plus reserved never exceeds the declared limit.

assumptions.title: Context freshness
assumptions.clarifying_question: Is the state still valid at effect time?
assumptions.failure_path: Balances, inventory, permissions and other preconditions can change between read and execution.

candidate_invariants.condition: Consequential transitions use an appropriately current or version-bound state.

assumptions.title: Nonlinear response load
assumptions.clarifying_question: Can recovery and oversight capacity absorb a correlated burst?
assumptions.failure_path: Nominal error rates may conceal a nonlinear overload of responders and queues.

candidate_invariants.condition: Critical response capacity remains within a declared operating envelope.

assumptions.title: Semantic drift across inputs
assumptions.clarifying_question: Do authority boundaries survive paraphrase and hostile formats?
assumptions.failure_path: Input variations or malicious content may redirect a model or parser beyond tested constraints.

candidate_invariants.condition: The declared validation and authority limits hold for the relevant input/adversary model.

assumptions.title: Fallback fail-closed continuity
assumptions.clarifying_question: Does a recovery path bypass the primary execution restriction?
assumptions.failure_path: On guard unavailability, fallback logic can allow an effect the normal admission path would reject.

candidate_invariants.condition: Unavailability of a critical guard does not silently open protected effects.

assumptions.title: Logs versus verifiable outcomes
assumptions.clarifying_question: Can recorded evidence substantiate an effect rather than merely report intent?
assumptions.failure_path: An integrity-protected record may still contain unverified outcome claims; intent and confirmation differ.

candidate_invariants.condition: Evaluation, dispatch, unknown and confirmed outcomes remain distinguishable and traceable.

assumptions.title: Meaningful human review
assumptions.clarifying_question: Is approval substantive or a rubber-stamp interaction?
assumptions.failure_path: Review throughput, missing context and habituation can make an approval nominal.

candidate_invariants.condition: Approval claimed as preventive is informed and can stop effect before execution.

assumptions.title: Optimization incentive divergence
assumptions.clarifying_question: Can throughput incentives reward bypassing protected constraints?
assumptions.failure_path: Local performance goals may favor paths that evade restrictions while improving visible metrics.

candidate_invariants.condition: Optimization does not override protected execution and authority boundaries.
